first.title: Isinyathelo esisodwa ngaphambi kokuthi ngiphendule
first.text: Umsizi {name} udinga ingqondo ukuze acabange: insiza ebhala izimpendulo. Indlela esheshayo yamahhala.
first.freeText: I-akhawunti yamahhala kusayithi le-OpenRouter, bese ubuyela lapha.
first.alsoText: {size}, kulandwa ngemuva, kokufanele kuhlale kule khompyutha.
first.plans: Sengivele ngisebenzisa i-ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini noma Copilot
first.chooseText: Eyimfihlo, esheshayo noma izimpendulo ezingcono kakhulu
first.neutral: Umsizi {name} akahlobene ne-OpenRouter, noma nanoma iyiphi enye insiza lapha. Ungakushintsha noma nini kuzilungiselelo.
first.private: Amagama ami kufanele ahlale kule khompyutha
first.privateText: Ingqondo eyimfihlo lapha, elandwa kanye ({size}). Izimpendulo ezilula nezihamba kancane, futhi isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
first.privateNo: Le khompyutha ayikwazi ukuqalisa ingqondo eyimfihlo.
first.nowText: I-akhawunti yamahhala kusayithi le-OpenRouter, ilunge ngomzuzu. Inemikhawulo yansuku zonke, futhi izimpendulo zivela efwini.
first.bestText: Ngensiza oyikhokhelayo: uhlelo lwe-ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini noma Copilot osunalo, noma ukhiye ovela kolunye lwazo.
first.names: La magama angawezinkampani zawo. Umsizi {name} akahlobene nanoma iyiphi yazo.
first.downloading: Kulandwa ingqondo eyimfihlo ({size}). Ize ilunge, izimpendulo zivela efwini.
